description:
Ever since he was a cub, Ryan has dreamed of adventuring across the world. But now that his parents--the King and Queen of Doong Doong Island--are missing, it falls on Ryan to rule the island as their heir...which means he can never leave. Rule or escape, which will Ryan choose?
